expected_behavior: A migration run prints a structured JSON plan on stdout whose every step carries package, fromVersion, toVersion, change, severity, fix and automated, plus the human-readable plan on stderr.
Exit 0 includes the legitimate empty-plan case: no known breaking changes applying is success, not a silent error.
A missing target (neither --target nor --all) and an unreadable package.json are usage errors that name themselves instead of proceeding.
